text_block_list.text:
One day, Fine Motion was receiving a 
regular briefing in the room where her SP 
bodyguards stayed—

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
Moving on, then— I shall report on the 
feedback received from the citizens of our 
home country.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
"My heart ached seeing such an intense 
race," and "I wonder if Lady Fine is 
having a hard time"—most of the messages 
expressed worry regarding your recent 
race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see... That is a serious matter, isn't 
it desu wa. Causing the people of Ireland 
to worry is the last thing I would ever 
desire.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Rather, I want everything I do here in 
Japan to bring them immense joy and 
happiness—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I shall think about whether there is a 
good solution as well desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming along with me today, 
Fine! I desperately needed someone to help 
me out...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
We're going to fully conquer the Usapii 
collab cafe!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I've been interested ever since I 
saw it on TV! These kinds of "fandom 
support" events!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, I don't really know how to enjoy 
them properly. Could you teach me the 
etiquette and various traditions desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Of course, leave it to me! Alright, let's 
head in right away!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Here is your Usapii 
Plate.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Waaah...! So cute! It's way too cute...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My, Usapii is drawn right onto the 
omurice! The egg looks so fluffy, too...! 
Shall we dig in right away desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait! Mind if I take some photos 
first? We have the plushie, and the 
acrylic stands—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the plushie's gaze looks better angled 
this way... Yep! That does it♪

text_block_list.name: Fine & Bubble
text_block_list.text: So cuuuute~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, why don't we put some accessories on 
it too? I happen to have brought several 
with me desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Great idea! It really brings out Usapii's 
charm! Let's keep snapping photos like 
this non-stop!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Aww! Another duplicate coaster! That final 
one feels so out of reach.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, there's still one more left! 
I'm sure it will come to you desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'll make sure my feelings 
reach it! Come to me... "Vacation Usapii"—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ah... ah... ah—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAY!! That makes a full complete set!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Wonderful~~! Your wish truly 
reached Usapii desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for coming home to me!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, every single coaster is so 
adorable. Look, this "Student Usapii." The 
swirly glasses suit it so well!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, perhaps it's just my imagination, 
but Usapii looks somehow overjoyed as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As if saying, "I'm so glad I could make 
Bubble-chan happy!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, exactly, Usapii. I'm so happy 
whenever I'm supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Seeing your cute self fills my heart, and 
then I can return all that energy right 
back to you—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's the real joy of being a fan! Pretty 
amazing, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
!! Indeed. It looks so fun, so full of 
happiness—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—How truly wonderful! Fandom culture... A 
culture that fills people with pure 
happiness...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see. Perhaps... To wipe away the worries 
of everyone watching over me back in 
Ireland—!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Bubble-san! I—have become quite 
fascinated with "fandom support" now♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, glad to hear it! Enjoy it to your 
heart's content, Fine!

One day, while having lunch on a bench, I 
caught sight of Fine Motion with a serious 
expression—

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
—Having the people of Ireland... engage in 
fandom support for Your Highness?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, I do not yet have a deep 
understanding of what it entails desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What truly is fandom support? How can I 
enable them to enjoy supporting me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
First, I must experience it firsthand to 
learn. I shall take on the challenge of 
fandom support myself desu wa!
